theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Highest momentum score (2.253) with strong breadth (0.875) and a durable trend bar (0.73), yet crowding_z is only 0.81 (not crowded) — a leadership theme that has not yet attracted excessive positioning. The absolute-trend gate is validated as drawdown control for this market, and AI Infra sits squarely within that eligible, trend-confirmed regime.
